Periaatekuva, ei mittakaavassa: kasa pol: Schematic illustration, not to scale: a pile of firewood contains chemical energy. When it burns, the wood turns into a flame in which the chemical energy is released as heat and light. The energy released is found by multiplying the mass of the fuel by the heat of combustion.
Vaakapylväskaavio polttoaineiden lämpöar: Horizontal bar chart of the heats of combustion of fuels in MJ/kg, rounded values: natural gas 49, petrol 43, diesel 43, coal 26, wood pellets 17, firewood 15 and peat 10. The bar lengths are to scale: the bar for natural gas is about five times as long as the bar for peat.
Periaatekuva ravintoarvomerkinnästä, esi: Schematic illustration of a nutrition label, an example and not a real product: the package says energy 2200 kJ per hundred grams. When the energy is converted to megajoules and the mass to kilograms, you get a number corresponding to the heat of combustion, 22 MJ/kg.
